doc.description: This module is an example module for the course AE4317 Autonomous Flight of Micro Air Vehicles at the TU Delft. This module is used with cv_group13 optical flow output and the navigation mode of the autopilot. The avoidance strategy is based purely on the optical-flow histogram signal (avg_flow). When the absolute value of avg_flow exceeds a threshold, we assume an obstacle is present and turn away.

define.name: OPTIC_FLOW_VISUAL_DETECTION_ID
define.description: Which VISUAL_DETECTION message to receive for optical-flow outputs.

define.name: MOTION_GROUP13_HIST_FLOW_THRESHOLD
define.description: Absolute avg_flow threshold above which an obstacle is considered close.

define.name: MOTION_GROUP13_HIST_FLOW_CLEAR_THRESHOLD
define.description: Absolute avg_flow threshold below which path is considered clear enough to fly forward.

define.name: MOTION_GROUP13_MIN_FORWARD_DISTANCE
define.description: Minimum forward waypoint step when peaks are near but not critical.

define.name: MOTION_GROUP13_GAP_BALANCE_THRESHOLD
define.description: If |avg_flow| is below this while close flow exists, treat as two-side peaks with a gap ahead.

define.name: MOTION_GROUP13_EMERGENCY_FLOW_THRESHOLD
define.description: Very close flow level that triggers stronger evasive turning and reduced forward step.

define.name: MOTION_GROUP13_FLOW_LPF_ENABLE
define.description: Enable (1) or disable (0) low-pass filtering of received avg_flow.

define.name: MOTION_GROUP13_FLOW_LPF_ALPHA
define.description: LPF alpha in [0..1] for avg_flow. Lower is smoother, higher is more responsive.
